Fasedienol PALISADE-4 Phase 3 Clinical Trial In June 2026, we announced topline and post-hoc data from the randomized portion of PALISADE-4, our U.S. multi-center, randomized, double-b lind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 clinical trial designed to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of a single dose of fasedienol in reducing anxiety symptoms in adults with social anxiety disorder during a simulated anxiety-provoking public speaking challenge with the Subjective Units of Distress Scale ( SUDS ) as the primary endpoint.

Fasedienol Exploratory Phase 2 Repeat Dose Study In August 2026, we announced topline results from the randomized portion of our repeat dose study of fasedienol, a three-arm, U.S. multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo controlled exploratory Phase 2 clinical study (N=61), which included an open label extension, designed to assess the efficacy, safety, and tolerability of two 3.2 µg doses of fasedienol administered ten minutes apart compared with a single 3.2 µg dose and placebo, for the acute treatment of anxiety induced by a public speaking challenge.

After receipt of negative top-line results from PALISADE-1 during the COVID-19 pandemic, we terminated PALISADE-2 prior to completion (after enrolling 141 patients out of a planned 208) and analyzed the data from the 141 enrolled subjects.

During the quarter ended December 31, 2025, we began realizing a decrease in research and development expenses as a result of cash preservation measures implemented following the announcement of top-line results from our PALISADE-3 clinical trial.
